This document is the consolidated text of the Census and Statistics Act [Chapter 10:29] (Act 1 of 2007), which establishes the Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency and commenced on 1 July 2009.

ZIMSTAT states that official statistics in Zimbabwe are carried out on the basis of the Census and Statistics Act from 2007, which sets up the Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency and its Board (no event date given, so the page's published date is used).
ZIMSTAT's acting director-general said the October 2026 listing exercise is conducted in terms of the Census and Statistics Act, which mandates ZIMSTAT to collect official statistics.
